feature: 姿态参考（图像指令） · 修复重试
claim_level: 作者站外视频显示姿态控制入口；未证实入口对应成功输出。本条只测试普通图像指令参考，不代表专用姿态控制或ControlNet能力。
prompt: Use image 1 only as a rough visual pose guide and image 2 only as the identity reference for the adult woman with curly copper-red hair, fair freckled skin and green eyes. Create one fully clothed, full-body photorealistic woman, front-facing on a plain white studio background. Reproduce the guide's stance as closely as possible: both arms straight out horizontally in a T-pose, feet apart, and the woman's anatomical left knee bent (the knee on the viewer-right side of image 1). Dress her in simple fitted dark teal athletic clothes and shoes. Do not copy the stick figure, colored joints, or diagram lines. Treat image 1 as a visual instruction, not as a hard pose constraint.
expected: An adult woman resembling image 2, shown full-body with approximately horizontal outstretched arms, separated legs and a bent anatomical left knee. Pose adherence is uncertain because this is only a two-image semantic edit prompt with a schematic reference, not a pose-control model or dedicated control node.
wiring_note: refs[0] becomes TextEncodeQwenImage21 images.image_1 (pose guide); refs[1] becomes images.image_2 (portrait identity). The pose guide is an instruction image and must not be described as hard-constraint control.
runtime_profile: Same Turbo UN weights and original prompt/seed; isolated reference/text/sampling/decode
retry_reason: 参考隔离后完整8步和CPU解码。红卷发成年女性、青色运动服、白背景、水平展开双臂及画面右侧屈膝可见，未复制骨架线；与示意的大体姿态相符。人物面部细节及精确身份不足，不能作为专用姿态约束或精确身份验收。
timing_scope: Sum of reference preparation, encoding, sampling and decode submission-to-history times; excludes service cold starts
acceptance_scope: 普通双图语义姿态跟随，大体动作达到；精确关节和身份未验收
